note: FDXR variants cause optic atrophy and auditory neuropathy (ANOA), with several reports indicating early-onset visual impairment and auditory neuropathy manifesting later in late childhood or adulthood (average onset around 11 years).

evidence.text: In a study of non-isolated auditory neuropathy associated with mitochondrial genes including FDXR, the onset of hearing loss ranged from 2 to 25 years with an average age of 11 years.

source.title: Identification of genetic mechanisms of non-isolated auditory neuropathy with various phenotypes in Chinese families
source.quote: Patients' age of hearing loss onset ranged from 2 to 25 years, averaging 11 years.
